name: Medieval Tower (中世纪塔楼)
use_for: castle towers, keeps, watchtowers, fortifications, anything 'medieval' or 'castle'

materials.primary_mix: 80% stone_bricks / 15% mossy_stone_bricks / 5% cracked_stone_bricks, mixed deterministically per-position (never uniform patches)
materials.secondary_use: timber framing, floor slabs between storeys, lintels over doors/windows
materials.accent_use: door, top-floor trim band, balcony/hoarding details

roof.type: gable (人字顶) or conical point for round towers
roof.slope: 45 degrees (1 in, 1 up per stair layer)
roof.material: dark_oak_stairs (wooden spire) or deepslate_tile_stairs (slate look) — ALWAYS distinct from wall material

windows.pattern: arrow-slit rhythm: one 1x2 window every 3 blocks of wall length, aligned in vertical columns per storey
windows.frame: stripped_spruce_log lintel above, stone_brick_stairs sill optional

details.crenellation: ALWAYS crown the wall top with merlons — patterns/crenellation.py, stone_brick_wall, spacing 2
details.buttress: corner buttresses on towers wider than 5 — patterns/buttress.py, stone_bricks, stepped 3-2-1
details.base: 1-2 block cobblestone/stone footing flare at ground contact, never floating
details.lighting: minecraft:lantern or minecraft:wall_torch every 5-6 blocks interior, one lantern by the door
details.interior_floor: spruce_planks storey slabs; ladder or spiral stair of spruce_stairs between floors

pilaster.note: towers use corner buttresses instead of pilasters; enable only on wall runs wider than 7 without buttresses

string_course.note: 1-block band at each storey slab line, plus the dark_oak trim band below the crenellation
